name: KorrPadel
summary:
KorrPadel is a padel simulation built around positioning, timing, and team play.
You choose how to play each ball: play it safe or go for a more aggressive shot. Read the trajectories, use the walls, and decide when to defend or attack.

You can play against the CPU, locally with up to 4 players, online, or in mixed local and online matches.

You can jump into quick matches or spend more time in career mode. Alongside classic 2v2, the game also includes alternative formats such as 1v1 on diagonal or narrower courts.

Visual assists are adjustable, from light guidance for a more simulation-oriented experience to more accessible settings.

Play across different court atmospheres, from large indoor venues to smaller club-style settings.
You can also customize your player with different faces, clothes, and racket types.

We play padel ourselves, and we want the game to stay true to the sport we love. The game includes the full range of padel shot options, from familiar shots like lobs and volleys to more specific padel shots like bandejas and viboras.
